stages.handoff:
Syslog configuration now has a public [syslog.Conf](/app/config/syslog/types.go) type with platform-specific `Validate()` methods. Configuration and reporting use the new type, while `config.SyslogConf` remains an alias for existing callers.

Validation preserves the existing accepted values and error counts. On Windows, enabled syslog returns the specified single error. The relevant package tests pass, and the Windows syslog and config tests compile.

Fixed `tctl auth sign --format=kubernetes` so generated kubeconfigs use an HTTPS Kubernetes proxy URL on port 3026, unless `--proxy` is explicitly set. Added `ProxyConfig.KubeAddr()` and a registered-proxy fallback that skips invalid public addresses.

Regression tests cover address selection and the generated kubeconfig. `go test ./lib/service ./tool/tctl/common -count=1` passed.

Added `timeOffset` support from the public and Subsonic stream endpoints through the media streamer and FFmpeg. Transcoded streams now use separate cache entries for different offsets. FFmpeg templates interpolate `%t`, and commands without that placeholder add `-ss` after the input only for nonzero offsets.

Updated the mocks and call sites, and advertised the extension in OpenSubsonic. The relevant Go tests and `git diff --check` pass.

Fixed the PassAliases drawer. It now shows existing aliases or a clear “No aliases” state, and “Get an alias” opens the creation modal. Vault lookup no longer creates a vault during drawer loading; the alias flow creates one when needed and refreshes the cached list after creation.

Verification passed: 3 focused drawer tests, TypeScript checks for Components and Pass, and `git diff --check`.

Updated Qt startup to initialize the wrapper machinery early and pass its `SelectionInfo` to the availability check. If no wrapper imports, `NoWrapperAvailableError` now includes the import failures and the current selection info. The change also clarifies selection formatting and debug output.

The relevant tests pass: **42 passed**, and `git diff --check` is clean. The full version test module stopped at its real Chromium check; the affected version-report tests pass when run directly.

Implemented the generic fanout buffer in [buffer.go](/app/lib/utils/fanoutbuffer/buffer.go). It supports independent ordered cursors, ring and overflow storage, grace period errors, blocking reads, and cleanup on cursor or buffer close.

Verification passed: the new package’s tests under the race detector and the existing `lib/services` fanout tests.

Updated the WinRM connection plugin to support `ansible_winrm_kinit_args`. It splits the argument string into tokens and passes them after the executable and before the principal. When set, those arguments take precedence over the default `-f` delegation flag in both subprocess and pexpect paths.

Added tests for custom arguments, delegation precedence, single invocation, and unique credential caches. **Verification:** all 34 WinRM unit tests pass; `git diff --check` is clean.

Updated [useLink.ts](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_links/useLink.ts) to reuse `NOT_FOUND`, `NOT_ALLOWED`, and `INVALID_ID` fetch errors for the same `(shareId, linkId)` for 30 seconds. Other links can still fetch normally, and successful responses continue through the existing processing path.

Added coverage in [useLink.test.ts](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_links/useLink.test.ts). All 17 tests in that suite passed; the Drive TypeScript check and `git diff --check` passed.

Added session renaming to the device details view for both the current session and other sessions. The form supports names up to 100 characters, including an empty name, and provides Save, Cancel, a saving indicator, and the required error message. Successful saves update the displayed name immediately.

The focused tests pass (48 tests across 5 suites). ESLint, stylelint, and `git diff --check` pass. The full type check remains blocked by three existing `IRequest.abort` errors in `matrix-js-sdk`.

Updated the message composer so replaced-room notices use paragraphs and clearly state that the room is no longer active. The reply preview now names the sender, and it and the search bar use a shared, accessible cancel button.

The relevant tests passed (16/16), as did ESLint and Stylelint. The type check still reports existing errors in `matrix-js-sdk` and room settings files; it reports no errors in the changed files.

Implemented the ansible-core fixes in `/app`: unset-value handling, legacy YAML constructors, `None` templar overrides, lookup messages, deprecation configuration and messaging, Boolean `timedout`, and early CLI error help text. Added regression tests and updated `.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md`.

**Verification:** 153 focused tests passed. A broader run encountered stdin fixture and cross-test state failures, so it did not pass as a whole.

Updated `custom_headers` so XHR requests leave the global `Accept-Language` header unset, allowing JavaScript’s custom header to be sent. A matching domain override still applies; other requests keep the global fallback.

The relevant unit tests pass: **29 passed**.

Updated [DocCLI.tty_ify](/app/lib/ansible/cli/doc.py:77) to render `L()`, `R()`, and `HORIZONTALLINE`, while preserving ordinary parenthesized words and the existing macro formats. Added regression coverage for mixed macros.

Verification: 36 relevant unit tests passed; `git diff --check` passed.

Resolved the listed NodeBB issues in the checked-out files: notification dropdowns now load through the clicked trigger and ignore stale responses; fork and move selectors render as dropups; quick search resets after navigation; and the hash, email, route, and template fixes are in place.

ESLint and `git diff --check` pass. The existing hash and email tests pass: **71 tests**.

Added `feature_qr_signin_reciprocate_show` as an experimental setting, disabled by default, with a description of the MSC3882 and MSC3886 homeserver requirements. The QR section and both settings tabs now show “Sign in with QR code” only when the flag is enabled and the server supports both protocols. “Show QR code” still opens the QR view until the flow is closed.

All 60 targeted tests passed. ESLint and Prettier passed on edited files. The full TypeScript check remains blocked by an unrelated existing error in [RoomView-test.tsx](/app/test/components/structures/RoomView-test.tsx:178).

Implemented host-scoped monitoring in `/app`. [OlAsyncIOScheduler](/app/scripts/monitoring/utils.py) uses asyncio, gives scheduled jobs function-name IDs, and keeps jobs only when `HOSTNAME` matches an exact name or trailing-asterisk prefix, including short names for fully qualified hosts. [monitor.py](/app/scripts/monitoring/monitor.py) now has an async entrypoint and a host-scoped HAProxy job; [haproxy_monitor.py](/app/scripts/monitoring/haproxy_monitor.py) adds CSV metric collection and Graphite output.

Verification: all 8 monitoring tests pass, Ruff passes, and a registry check showed four jobs on `ol-www0.us.archive.org` and none on `other-server`.

Added SQL Server support to the database connection diagnostic flow. The new pinger validates connection parameters, respects context timeouts during login, and categorizes unreachable servers, login failures, and invalid database names. Unsupported protocols still return an error.

Both relevant test packages pass: `go test ./lib/client/conntest/database ./lib/client/conntest -count=1`.

Updated [config.go](/app/internal/config/config.go) so scalar strings decode into `[]string` using whitespace as the separator. This handles repeated, leading, and trailing whitespace and produces an empty slice for an empty string. YAML sequences remain unchanged, and empty ENV values now reach the decoder.

Added YAML and ENV coverage and updated the advanced config fixture. `go test ./internal/config` and `git diff --check` pass.

Updated `Roles.Check` to reject duplicate roles while preserving rejection of unknown roles. Updated `Roles.Equals` to compare distinct-role sets, regardless of order or duplicates, and to treat nil and empty lists as equal.

The targeted role tests pass. The full `lib/utils` suite has one unrelated failure: a certificate fixture expired in 2021.

Implemented Redis cache TLS configuration in `/app`. `RedisCacheConfig` now accepts `ca_cert_path`, `ca_cert_bytes`, and `insecure_skip_tls`; validation rejects both CA options together. The new [NewClient](/app/internal/cache/redis/client.go) applies those options and requires TLS 1.2 when TLS is enabled. I also updated the schemas, YAML fixtures, and the `api/cachetls` integration matrix entry.

Config, command, and new client tests pass. The Docker based Redis tests and integration suite could not run because this environment has no Docker daemon.

Updated the list model with explicit seed types and method annotations. Seed membership now compares normalized keys across `Thing`, `SeedDict`, and subject strings; subject keys normalize consistently; and export always returns type-filtered `authors`, `works`, and `editions` lists. I also added regression tests and string annotations to the URL helpers.

Verification: 6 relevant tests passed, and Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

Updated the RPM scanner to keep binary package metadata and append a warning when a source RPM filename cannot be parsed. Source filenames with an epoch now produce the expected source version and retain the link to the binary package.

Added tests for both reported filenames and for scan continuation. The focused scanner tests and `git diff --check` passed.

Authentication now connects to a database only when flag storage uses one or an enabled authentication method requires one. JWT is explicitly marked as database-free; static token, OIDC, GitHub, and Kubernetes are marked as database-backed. Cleanup runs only for enabled database-backed methods with a schedule.

Added tests for method selection and JWT startup with Local, Git, and OCI storage. `go test ./internal/config ./internal/cmd ./internal/cleanup` passed.

Updated author matching to compare extracted birth and death years across date formats, try exact names before alternate names and surname matches, and treat asterisks in names literally. Honorific removal now accepts a string and handles exceptions and honorific-only names. New author records retain input fields except the importer’s temporary `db_name` field.

Verification: **245 passed, 1 expected failure** across the add-book and catalog utility tests. `git diff --check` passed.

YAML values that exactly match `${VARIABLE_NAME}` now resolve from the environment during configuration decoding, before type conversion. Missing variables and values that do not match the pattern remain unchanged. Existing `FLIPT_` environment overrides still take precedence.

Added tests for multiple substitutions, integer ports, string values, overrides, and unchanged values. The full `internal/config` test package passes.

Updated Vuls to use every CVE content source associated with an OS family. Ubuntu reports now include UbuntuAPI details in source URLs, vulnerability fields, and CVSS v3 scores; change detection also checks that source. `NEGLIGIBLE` severity now maps to the low CVSS range.

Added focused tests. `go test ./models ./reporter ./detector` passed offline, and `git diff --check` passed.

Fixed public bookmark session restoration in [getLastPersistedLocalID](/app/applications/drive/src/app/utils/lastActivePersistedUserSession.ts) and its [bookmark caller](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_views/useBookmarksPublicView.ts). The synchronous, read-only lookup now returns `null` when no valid session ID exists, ignores invalid keys, and preserves a valid ID of `0`. The bookmark view resumes a session only when an ID is available.

The focused tests passed, including the utility suite after the final validation change. Prettier and `git diff --check` also passed.

Added `getCachedChildrenCount(shareId, parentLinkId)` to [useLinksListing.tsx](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/links/useLinksListing.tsx). It returns the length of the cached children for that share and parent.

The updated tests cover fetched counts and share and parent isolation. All 32 tests in the three relevant suites passed.

Added [nios_fixed_address.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/net_tools/nios/nios_fixed_address.py) to create, update, and delete IPv4 and IPv6 DHCP fixed addresses, with check mode, DHCP options, comments, and extensible attributes. Updated [api.py](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/net_tools/nios/api.py) with fixed address object types and MAC-based lookup. Added [unit tests](/app/test/units/modules/net_tools/nios/test_nios_fixed_address.py).

Verification: all 68 NIOS unit tests passed.

Updated the AIX hardware collector so `processor_count` is 1, `processor_cores` counts available processor devices, SMT supplies `processor_threads_per_core` with a default of 1, and `processor_vcpus` is their product. `processor` is now a list.

Added AIX unit tests. The hardware fact test suite passed: **17 tests**.

Fixed the default configuration path. `config.Load("")` now applies `FLIPT_` environment overrides to defaults, and startup calls it when no config file is found. File-based configuration still uses environment values where they are set.

Added tests for default and file-based values, including `FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL` and `FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT`. `go test ./internal/config ./cmd/flipt` passed.

Updated [async_wrapper.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/async_wrapper.py) to use one JSON termination routine, write job records atomically, and include consistent job IDs and lifecycle fields in results. Startup, fork, and timeout failures now produce structured errors; timeout records include the child PID.

Expanded [test_async_wrapper.py](/app/test/units/modules/test_async_wrapper.py) to cover those paths and temporary directory cleanup. All 7 tests pass; syntax and diff checks pass.

U2F login now generates challenges for every registered U2F device. The response keeps the legacy single challenge fields, while the CLI accepts the full challenge list so users can authenticate with any registered token. Web endpoints return the enhanced payload, and the MFA management command is hidden from help.

Added compatibility and multi-device login tests. `go test ./lib/auth ./lib/client ./lib/web ./tool/tsh -count=1` passes.

Updated the IA importer to place ISBNs in `isbn_10` and `isbn_13`, and to split publisher names and publication places into `publishers` and `publish_places`. Added public utilities for both conversions and tests covering strings, mixed lists, whitespace, and empty inputs.

The relevant tests pass: **31 passed**. `git diff --check` also passed.

Implemented the evaluator split. `Server.Evaluate` now delegates to `storage.Evaluator`, and [EvaluatorStorage](/app/storage/evaluator.go) owns flag lookup, constraint matching, and variant selection. The evaluation path now preserves rule rank, handles case insensitive operators and trimmed strings, and uses deterministic CRC32 rollout cutoffs.

Updated the mocks and added focused evaluator tests. `GOPROXY=off go test ./storage ./server` passes.

Updated [config.go](/app/config/config.go) so `Load` reads the three DB pool options and `meta.check_for_updates`. An absent update-check key now defaults to `false`, while absent keys leave the other defaults intact. Expanded the config tests to cover explicit values and field-for-field equality with `Default()`.

`go test ./...` and `git diff --check` passed.

Fixed the undefined-variable error path. `AnsibleDumper` now triggers Jinja’s undefined error for `AnsibleUndefined`; both YAML filters report named `AnsibleFilterError` failures with the original cause preserved; and template rendering surfaces those failures as `AnsibleUndefinedVariable`. Supported YAML values retain their existing behavior.

The relevant tests passed: **65 passed**.

Implemented transparent gzip decoding for HTTP responses in [urls.py](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/urls.py), with `decompress` controls passed through [uri.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/uri.py) and [get_url.py](/app/lib/ansible/modules/get_url.py). Gzip responses remain compressed when `decompress: false`. Missing gzip support now produces a deprecation warning and an actionable error if the server still sends gzip.

Verification: all 84 URL utility unit tests passed; `git diff --check` passed.

Fixed `Booknotes.update_work_id` so a work ID collision rolls back the update and preserves every booknote. It now returns a dictionary with `rows_changed`, `rows_deleted`, and `failed_deletes`; a conflict returns `0`, `0`, and `1`. The admin caller now passes through that dictionary.

The relevant tests pass: **5 passed**, including the new conflict regression test.

Removed `ListMixin` and moved its methods into `List`. List owner lookup now parses `/people/{username}/lists/{list_id}` and returns `None` when the path is invalid or the user is missing. Added `register_models()` in [lists/model.py](/app/openlibrary/core/lists/model.py) to register `/type/list` and the `lists` changeset.

Verification: 18 model tests and the list engine test passed; `git diff --check` passed. A separate list page test fails because `web.ctx.env` is unset, and the list API tests cannot collect because `cookielib` is unavailable in this Python 3 environment.

Added `/.well-known/webfinger` through a dedicated [controller](/app/src/controllers/well-known.js) and [route](/app/src/routes/well-known.js), mounted at startup. It validates `resource`, checks `view:users` access under the Guest role for anonymous requests, resolves the user slug, and returns a WebFinger JSON response with the subject, profile aliases, and an HTML profile link.

Added regression tests. ESLint, `git diff --check`, and isolated handler checks passed. The integration tests could not start because local Redis refused connections at `127.0.0.1:6379`.

Tracing setup now lives in [internal/tracing/tracing.go](/app/internal/tracing/tracing.go). It provides the resource, always-on provider, and Jaeger, Zipkin, and OTLP exporter constructors. [grpc.go](/app/internal/cmd/grpc.go) uses those functions and registers exporter shutdown in its lifecycle. Exporter calls use their own configuration, so one call cannot reuse another call’s exporter.

Tests cover environment resource attributes, sampling, exporter calls, endpoint errors, and OTLP HTTP headers and path. `go test ./internal/tracing ./internal/cmd` and `git diff --check` passed.

Resolved namespace listing for users without access to `default`. Both authorization engines now evaluate viewable namespaces; the middleware passes the result to `ListNamespaces`, which filters the response and total count. The UI redirects namespace routes to an accessible namespace when needed.

`go test ./internal/server/authz/... ./internal/server -count=1` passed. UI tests were not run because local UI dependencies are absent.

Collection name validation now returns `False` when either segment is a Python keyword or an invalid Python identifier. The Galaxy resolver uses the same check, and the legacy helpers and Python 2/3 compatibility code have been removed from `dataclasses.py`.

The 71 collection loader tests and 7 new resolver cases pass. The broader Galaxy install suite could not complete in a direct pytest run because its collection finder was not installed during fixture setup.

Updated [module_common.py](/app/lib/ansible/executor/module_common.py) to resolve `module_utils` dependencies with a queue and separate legacy and collection locators. The payload now includes redirect shims, handles relative imports in package initializers, synthesizes missing package files, normalizes `six` imports, and reports attempted paths when resolution fails.

Added regression coverage and updated the base package assertions. **Validation:** all 51 executor `module_common` tests pass; `git diff --check` is clean.

Implemented per-ID `SetSeed` on the global hasher and on `Hasher`. Reusing a seed restores the same hash, reseeding changes it, and IDs without a seed initialize automatically. Seed map access is synchronized.

The hasher, database, and persistence tests pass. Explicit seeds reproduce hashes across hasher instances **within one process**; `maphash` uses a process-specific seed, so results are not guaranteed across restarts.

Resolved the plugin routing issue in the checked-out files. The loader now exposes `get_with_context`, including resolution metadata when a plugin is missing or removed. Tombstones raise `AnsiblePluginRemovedError` with context; deprecation messages use one formatter; and the connection, action, and Jinja callers use the updated behavior.

Added focused tests and updated the action loader mock. Verification passed: 81 loader, template, collection, and display tests; 28 executor and action tests; and `git diff --check`.

Updated the email confirmation flow to store a UID-to-code mapping and an explicit expiry timestamp. ACP validation can now find a pending email when the profile email is empty, expired codes cannot be used, and account deletion removes both confirmation keys. The user list now shows **Validated**, **Validation Pending**, **Validation Expired**, or **(no email)**.

Verification: 5 focused confirmation tests passed; ESLint and `git diff --check` passed.

Updated the album, artist, and share models so optional timestamps can be null, and made album `image_files` nullable to address the reported scan error. Added `gg.P` and `gg.V` and updated the affected read and write paths.

The relevant Go tests and `git diff --check` pass. A broader run failed in unrelated TagLib fixture and file-permission tests.

`tsh` now reads `TELEPORT_KUBE_CLUSTER` into its CLI configuration. A cluster specified with `--kube-cluster` takes precedence. The existing `TELEPORT_CLUSTER` and `TELEPORT_SITE` precedence remains in place, and a test now covers `TELEPORT_HOME` overriding a CLI home path while removing a trailing slash.

The focused tests for all three settings passed.

Implemented token accounting for `Chat.Complete` and `Agent.PlanAndExecute`. Both now return a non-nil `*model.TokenCount`; the agent accumulates prompt and completion usage across steps, including streamed responses. The Assist and web callers now use those totals, and tests cover counter behavior and multi-step usage.

The chat and model tests pass, as does the chat race test. The broader package run remains blocked by missing system C headers and optional hardware dependencies in this environment.

Updated [oval/util.go](/app/oval/util.go:280) so `major("")` returns `""` without panicking. Non-empty parsing remains unchanged, and [the existing test table](/app/oval/util_test.go:1094) now covers empty input.

The `oval` tests and `report` package build pass.

Added `singleton.GetInstance[T](constructor func() T) T` in [singleton.go](/app/utils/singleton/singleton.go). It caches `T` and `*T` separately and runs each type’s constructor once, even under concurrent calls.

Added tests for reuse, type separation, and 20,000 simultaneous calls in [singleton_test.go](/app/utils/singleton/singleton_test.go). The singleton package passes `go test -race`.

Trivy scan results now store the OS version in `Release` and use the artifact name for `ServerName`, adding `:latest` for untagged container images. They no longer store `trivy-target` in `Optional`. The detector identifies Trivy results through `ScannedBy` and runs OVAL/GOST only when package detection is supported.

Updated parser and detector tests pass: `go test ./contrib/trivy/parser/v2 ./detector`.

Added `image/jxl` and its extension mapping, enabled HEIC/HEIF and JXL previews on macOS and iOS Safari 17+, and simplified MIME detection in both Drive upload parsers to use `File.type` with an extension fallback.

The existing thumbnail test, Prettier, and `git diff --check` passed. Type checks are blocked by errors in unchanged crypto and Drive Store files; targeted ESLint ran out of memory.

Implemented YAML-native variant attachments in [internal/ext](/app/internal/ext/common.go) and connected the import and export CLI commands to it. Export renders stored JSON attachments as YAML structures; import converts YAML structures back to JSON strings and accepts existing JSON object or array strings. Missing attachments remain empty.

Focused attachment tests, CLI package checks, and storage tests pass. The referenced `internal/ext/testdata` fixtures are absent from this checkout, so I could not compare output against them.

Updated [PosthogAnalytics.ts](/app/src/PosthogAnalytics.ts) to use `Anonymity` state, force anonymous mode under DNT, validate configuration, gate capture on enabled and initialized state, hash user and room IDs, and reset PostHog on logout. Expanded [the tests](/app/test/PosthogAnalytics-test.ts) to cover those behaviors.

All 17 focused tests pass. ESLint and `git diff --check` pass. The full TypeScript check still reports unrelated repository and dependency errors; it reported none in `PosthogAnalytics`.

Added a public [Dialog](/app/packages/components/components/dialog/Dialog.tsx) wrapper and switched [ModalTwo](/app/packages/components/components/modalTwo/Modal.tsx) to use it. It forwards attributes and refs to a native dialog when supported, and uses an accessible host in limited DOM environments so open modal children remain discoverable by role.

Verified with 10 targeted tests, the component TypeScript check, ESLint, and `git diff --check`.

Updated author import to match by Open Library key first, then external identifiers, then name and dates. It now preserves identifiers on new authors, saves identifiers merged into matched authors, raises `AuthorRemoteIdConflictError` for conflicts, and uses deterministic tie breaking. Added `SUSPECT_DATE_EXEMPT_SOURCES` with `["wikisource"]`.

Verification: 149 relevant tests passed; Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

Implemented the process-to-package lookup fix. Debian and Red Hat scans now use a shared `pkgPs` function to collect process file paths and associate processes with packages by ownership. The RPM lookup deduplicates package names across architectures, ignores the three expected file lookup messages, and returns an error for malformed output.

Added an RPM parser test. `GOPROXY=off go test ./scan -count=1` and `git diff --check` pass.

Updated `ContextReader` to restore terminal state when a password read is canceled or the reader closes. Canceled reads return to a clean state, deadline expiry returns an empty result with `context.DeadlineExceeded`, and `Close` reports restoration errors. Added `NotifyExit` and called it when `tsh` finishes running.

The prompt package tests pass, including new regression tests. `git diff --check` passes. The broader `tsh` test command was stopped during lengthy dependency compilation, so that package remains unverified.

Implemented `proxy_service.kube_listen_addr` as a shorthand that enables the Kubernetes proxy and uses the Kubernetes default port when no port is given. Configuration now rejects an enabled legacy Kubernetes block alongside the shorthand, accepts an explicitly disabled block with the shorthand, and warns when both Kubernetes and proxy services are enabled without a proxy Kubernetes listen address.

Client address resolution now uses the web proxy host for unspecified listen hosts (`0.0.0.0` and `::`) and gives configured Kubernetes public addresses priority. Existing legacy configuration remains supported.

Verification passed: `go test ./lib/config ./lib/client` and `git diff --check`.

Updated `useMyCountry` to return a country code or `undefined`, and changed its callers to consume that single value. The user-settings loading checks remain in place.

`PhoneInput` now starts with no country when `defaultCountry` is empty or undefined. It adopts the first non-empty default that arrives after mount only if its country state is empty, then ignores later default changes.

The relevant Jest suites passed: 16 tests across 2 suites. `git diff --check` also passed.

Added `transformStyleAttributes` to replace inline `height` values containing `vh` with `auto`, including on the root element. It preserves other styles and any `!important` priority. The HTML preparation pipeline now calls it after `transformStylesheet` and before `transformRemote`.

Verification: the new test and the existing remote transform test passed (5 tests total); formatting and `git diff --check` passed.

Added `scrolling.bar=overlay`. It enables `--enable-features=OverlayScrollbar` only on QtWebEngine with Qt 5.11 or newer outside macOS; other scrollbar values never add the flag. Legacy `False` now migrates to `overlay`. I also updated the settings documentation and added `@js_headers` handling for the affected Qt versions.

The focused flag and migration tests passed, and both tagged header scenarios collected. The test process reported an X server I/O error after the passes, so it exited nonzero; the end-to-end scenarios were collected but not run.

Updated the single and batch loaders, `EntityClient`, and `DefaultEntityRestCache` to carry optional owner-encrypted session keys through to decryption. Mail detail callers now supply the parent mail’s key when available. Added tests for key application before decryption and for cache forwarding, including an omitted batch key map.

TypeScript checking and the focused REST client, cache, mail indexer, inbox rule, and mail facade suites passed.

On FreeBSD versions that return a structured boot time instead of a numeric string, the fact is omitted as required by the numeric-only rule.

`GUIProcess` now shows stdout and stderr live when output messages are enabled. It publishes a final summary for each nonempty stream, with stdout as informational before stderr as an error. Captured output is cleared when the process is reused.

A subagent added the focused tests, and another reviewed the stream behavior. I integrated the patch and verified it: **42 `GuiProcess` tests pass**, and `git diff --check` passes.

Updated [ec2.go](/app/lib/utils/ec2.go) so `IsAvailable` retrieves `instance-id` through the IMDS client within 250 ms and accepts only valid EC2 instance IDs. `NewInstanceMetadataClient` now accepts functional options, including `WithIMDSClient`. Added captive portal, ID validation, option, and timeout tests in [ec2_test.go](/app/lib/utils/ec2_test.go).

`go test ./lib/utils ./lib/labels/ec2` passed. A `lib/service` compile check failed because the container lacks required C headers. I delegated a call-site review and test implementation to two agents, then integrated and verified the patch.

Fixed the password lookup in [password.py](/app/lib/ansible/plugins/lookup/password.py). It now loads plugin options before parsing, applies inline values ahead of option defaults, and accepts `chars` as a list or comma-separated string while preserving `',,'` as a literal comma.

A delegated agent updated [the unit tests](/app/test/units/plugins/lookup/test_password.py) after a separate delegated code audit. Final verification passed: **35 unit tests**, **31 integration tasks**, and `git diff --check`.

Fixed the invalid `hosts` crash in [Play](/app/lib/ansible/playbook/play.py). `Play.load` no longer derives or mutates `name`; `get_name()` derives unnamed play names dynamically, and `_validate_hosts()` raises the requested `AnsibleParserError` messages. I updated the list output, callback bridge, and error assertion to use the new behavior.

Verification passed: 253 playbook unit tests, 32 CLI and callback tests, 68 collection loader tests, and the existing playbook integration script. An end-to-end check of a mapping inside `hosts` returned a parser error instead of a traceback. Delegated repository and test surveys helped identify the affected consumers; delegated regression tests are included in [test_play.py](/app/test/units/playbook/test_play.py).

Resolved the tsh test environment failures. `Run` and its command handlers now return errors, runtime options can be applied after parsing, and a mock SSO login function is passed through to the client. Auth and Proxy services now propagate their OS assigned listener addresses, including ports chosen for `:0`.

I added regression coverage for returned CLI errors and dynamic proxy addresses. The client, service, and tsh package tests pass with module network access disabled; `git diff --check` passes.

Three subagents handled the client, service, and `tsh.go` edits. I integrated the database handler changes and tests, then verified the final patch.

Fixed [Solr work document selection](/app/openlibrary/solr/update_work.py:746): a public IA edition now takes priority for `lending_edition_s`, and `lending_identifier_s` comes from that same edition. `lendinglibrary` editions are classified as loanable.

Updated [regression tests](/app/openlibrary/tests/solr/test_update_work.py:302) to cover mixed editions, multiple print-disabled IDs, collection and IA ID aggregation, and lending fallback. Two agents helped inspect the builder and add tests; I integrated and verified the patch.

`python -m pytest openlibrary/tests/solr -q`: **61 passed**. `git diff --check`: passed.

Implemented selective SSE delivery. The UI sends a per-window UUID on its requests; [server middleware](/app/server/middlewares.go:55) stores it in an HttpOnly cookie and request context. The [broker](/app/server/events/sse.go:113) now sends request events only to other clients of the same user, while events without a client ID broadcast to all. I also updated event call sites and stream reconnection.

I delegated the UI, middleware, and broker changes to three agents, then integrated and verified the patch. `go test ./...` passed, as did all 41 UI tests, lint, formatting, and `git diff --check`.

Book imports now remove the `cover` field and send its URL to the cover store only when `process_cover_url` accepts its HTTP or HTTPS host. The check covers both new and matched editions in [add_book/__init__.py](/app/openlibrary/catalog/add_book/__init__.py:354).

I delegated the host investigation and regression tests, then reviewed the combined patch. The proxy’s authoritative allow-list is not in this checkout, so `ALLOWED_COVER_HOSTS` uses hosts evidenced by local import code and tests.

Validation: **150 passed, 1 expected failure** in the `add_book` test package; Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

Implemented native DynamoDB `FieldsMap` storage for all audit event write paths. New readers accept both `FieldsMap` and legacy `Fields`, and the conversion preserves empty values, nested data, and large numbers. See [event_fields.go](/app/lib/events/dynamoevents/event_fields.go) and [dynamoevents.go](/app/lib/events/dynamoevents/dynamoevents.go).

The [migration](/app/lib/events/dynamoevents/fieldsmap_migration.go) uses a distributed lock, resumable page checkpoints, conditional batches of up to 25 updates, semantic validation, and record-level error logging. It also preserves older pagination cursors.

Delegated the format, migration, and backend helper work to native subagents, then reviewed and verified the combined patch. `go test ./lib/backend ./lib/events/dynamoevents -count=1` passed. The AWS-dependent integration suite was skipped by its existing test gate.

**Rollout limits:** older binaries cannot read map-only rows during a mixed-version deployment. The hourly sweep for late legacy writes scans the full table.

Updated [meraki.py](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/network/meraki/meraki.py:41) so requests retry HTTP 429, 500, and 502 up to three times, expose the latest status, and raise the new exception types. Recovered rate limits appear as task warnings; exhausted rate limits include the retry count in the exception message.

Updated [test_meraki.py](/app/test/units/module_utils/network/meraki/test_meraki.py:78). **16 tests pass**, and `git diff --check` is clean. One delegated agent wrote the focused tests; another reviewed the patch. I integrated and verified the final changes.

Updated [QtColor](/app/qutebrowser/config/configtypes.py:990) so HSV/HSVA hue percentages scale to 359, while the other channels scale to 255. It now rejects unsupported color function names and incorrect component counts before constructing a `QColor`.

Expanded [the existing tests](/app/tests/unit/config/test_configtypes.py:1235) for hue endpoints, RGB/A percentages, and invalid functions. The focused suite passed **33 tests**, and `git diff --check` was clean. A delegated agent reviewed the final patch and found no remaining requirement gaps.

Implemented the local staged-record lookup in [imports.py](/app/openlibrary/core/imports.py:125). It combines each identifier with the fixed `amazon` and `idb` sources, then returns all matching `staged` or `pending` rows as a ResultSet. [ISBN resolution](/app/openlibrary/core/models.py:409) now uses that lookup for both ISBN-13 and ISBN-10.

Two subagents inspected the query conventions and added focused tests; I reviewed and verified the combined patch. **20 tests passed** across the import and model suites. Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.

Fixed the room load flow. [RoomView](/app/src/components/structures/RoomView.tsx) now dispatches exactly `{ action: Action.RoomLoaded }` after loading and preserves the focused event when the store returns a nullish ID. [RoomViewStore](/app/src/stores/RoomViewStore.tsx) recomputes widget buttons on that new action, including without a prior `ViewRoom`; navigation no longer recomputes them.

Two delegated agents added the store and view tests. I integrated their changes and ran both suites together: **68 tests and 8 snapshots passed**. ESLint, Prettier, and whitespace checks passed. The full TypeScript check still reports errors in untouched SDK and OIDC files.

Updated [GUIProcess](/app/qutebrowser/misc/guiprocess.py:82) to show the capitalized process name, exact command, error type, and process detail. Missing or nonexecutable commands now get the requested hint on non-Windows platforms. Detached start failures use the same format, and crashes produce one notification.

A review agent checked the error paths, and a second agent updated the [unit tests](/app/tests/unit/misc/test_guiprocess.py:243) and [:spawn scenario](/app/tests/end2end/features/spawn.feature:9). I integrated the changes and verified that all 31 GUI process unit tests and the targeted end-to-end scenario pass.

Resolved the Trivy source separation issue. The [converter](/app/contrib/trivy/pkg/converter.go) and [library detector](/app/detector/library.go) now create `trivy:<source>` CVE contents with each source’s severity and CVSS, preserve references and dates, and merge repeated CVEs. The [model aggregation](/app/models/cvecontents.go) and [TUI](/app/tui/tui.go) now recognize and display those entries.

I delegated the converter, detector, and models/TUI edits, then reviewed the combined patch. The relevant tests passed offline with `go test -count=1 ./models ./tui ./detector ./contrib/trivy/pkg ./contrib/trivy/parser/v2`; formatting and `git diff --check` also passed.

Implemented the public session fix in both Drive copies. [getLastActivePersistedUserSession](/app/applications/drive/src/app/utils/lastActivePersistedUserSession.ts) now returns the valid persisted session with the highest `persistedAt`, including its UID and local ID. An opt-in strict read in [persistedSessionStorage.ts](/app/packages/shared/lib/authentication/persistedSessionStorage.ts) makes malformed data and storage failures return `null` with an error report.

The public session provider now resumes that session and restores auth and user state. The public user hook reads the local ID from auth, telemetry uses the selected UID, and the old `LAST_ACTIVE_PING` dependency is removed.

**Verification:** 43 focused tests passed across 8 suites; `git diff --check` passed. Type checks remain blocked by an unrelated OpenPGP type error in [api.ts](/app/packages/crypto/lib/worker/api.ts:579). I delegated the helper, provider, and telemetry changes to three agents, then reviewed and tested the integrated patch.

Fixed IA imports without MARC records. [ImportAPI](/app/openlibrary/plugins/importapi/code.py:338) now separates semicolon-delimited locations from publisher names, keeps `publishers` as a list, and classifies ISBNs by trimmed length. The parsing helpers are in [upstream utils](/app/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/utils.py:1193), and the canonical ISBN helper is in [isbn.py](/app/openlibrary/utils/isbn.py:5).

I delegated the parser, ISBN utility, and ImportAPI changes to three agents, then integrated and verified the patch. **All 69 affected tests passed**; `git diff --check` passed.

Implemented optional TLS ciphers for `get_url`, `uri`, and `lookup('url')`. The shared URL code accepts an ordered list or OpenSSL cipher string and carries the configured context through redirects, proxies, and Unix sockets. Invalid values produce sanitized errors; unset ciphers are passed through as `None`.

Module and lookup wiring and focused tests were delegated, then integrated and verified. **143 URL and lookup tests passed**; compilation and `git diff --check` passed. The reported CentOS 7 endpoint was not tested live.

Updated [make_work](/app/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/addbook.py:69) to return a `web.Storage` when either author field is missing, with an empty `authors` list and the requested metadata defaults. It preserves supplied fields, including `cover_url`, and adds the requested type annotations.

A subagent added [regression tests](/app/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/tests/test_addbook.py:25); I reviewed the patch and reran the test file. **15 tests passed**, and `git diff --check` passed.

Updated [the configuration schema](/app/qutebrowser/config/configdata.yml) to use `always`, `auto`, and `never`, with `auto` as the default. [WebEngine argument handling](/app/qutebrowser/config/qtargs.py) now passes version and CLI context to the setting resolver; `auto` adds the canvas flag only on Qt 6 with a known Chromium major version below 111.

A subagent added [boundary and resolver tests](/app/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py), and another inspected the version and schema conventions. I reviewed their work and verified the combined patch: **146 tests passed** with `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen`; `git diff --check` passed.

Updated [authenticate](/app/lib/kube/proxy/forwarder.go:316) so access-related failures remain `AccessDenied`, while lookup and setup failures retain their original trace classification. The no-tunnel `BadParameter` in `setupContext` is unchanged.

Added the requested [httplib error-writer wrappers](/app/lib/httplib/httplib.go:44) and classification tests. Two subagents handled the proxy tests and httplib wrappers; I reviewed the combined changes.

Verification passed: `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test -mod=vendor ./lib/httplib ./lib/kube/proxy`.

Implemented startup validation for enabled GitHub authentication and each configured OIDC provider. Missing or blank `client_id`, `client_secret`, and `redirect_address` now return the required provider and field error. GitHub’s `read:org` check remains in place with the specified error text. OIDC errors preserve the provider key’s YAML spelling.

Added load tests for the required fields, disabled methods, multiple OIDC providers, and a mixed-case provider key. Tests passed for `internal/config`, `internal/cmd`, and both GitHub and OIDC auth method packages with module fetching disabled.

Two subagents reviewed the validation path and tests, then contributed the tests and YAML key preservation. I integrated and verified the final patch.

Updated [audit types and constructors](/app/internal/server/audit/types.go:136) with the requested JSON operator fields. A single segment supplies its key; multiple segments produce comma-separated keys and the operator name. Legacy single keys remain supported.

Added [regression tests](/app/internal/server/audit/types_test.go:175) for those cases and JSON omission. Two subagents reviewed the models and added tests; I integrated the patch and verified that `go test -mod=readonly ./internal/server/audit/...` and `git diff --check` pass.

Resolved the mailbox reload issue. List loading now waits until all tracked backend item changes finish, and its loading state uses the current page and query parameters. Failed fetches retry after 2 seconds; responses marked stale are discarded and retried after 1 second. Added coverage for retry timing and deferred reloads.

I delegated the action, response type, and backend hook changes, then integrated and verified the patch. All 25 relevant tests passed, along with TypeScript, targeted ESLint, and `git diff --check`.

Implemented reusable payment verification in [paymentTokenHelper.tsx](/app/packages/components/containers/payments/paymentTokenHelper.tsx). Token creation now accepts an injected verifier: chargeable tokens return immediately, pending tokens enter verification, and terminal failures reject. Polling uses configurable timers and cleans up on completion or cancellation.

Wired the five requested components and the additional single-signup caller. Updated PayPal callers to proceed only when verification returns a chargeable outcome. Three native subagents handled the helper, consumer edits, and tests; I integrated and verified their changes.

TypeScript checks, ESLint, Prettier, and `git diff --check` passed. The helper suite passed 22/22 tests, PaymentStep passed 2/2, and the broader component run passed 33/35. The two remaining [CreditsModal test](/app/packages/components/containers/payments/CreditsModal.test.tsx) failures expect `PaymentMethodID` in the final credit request; the pre-refactor component and [API contract](/app/packages/shared/lib/api/payments.ts:175) both send the token payment without that field.

Updated the Kubernetes backend to export `NamespaceEnv` and `ReleaseNameEnv` and use them when reading the namespace and release name. [The tests](/app/lib/backend/kubernetes/kubernetes_test.go) now set the required variables explicitly, check the exact missing-variable errors, and verify the resulting configuration and Helm annotations.

`GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test ./lib/backend/kubernetes` passed. Two subagents reviewed the backend and tests; one updated the tests, and I integrated and verified the patch.

Implemented `incrObjectFieldByBulk` in [Mongo](/app/src/database/mongo/hash.js) and [Redis](/app/src/database/redis/hash.js). Both validate tuple input and safe integer increments, apply atomic updates per key, create missing fields, and invalidate cache entries for successful keys. Redis also supports existing decimal values where the increment can be represented reliably.

Three agents handled the Mongo implementation, Redis implementation, and [focused tests](/app/test/database/hash-bulk.js); I reviewed and verified the combined patch. **17 tests pass**, along with ESLint, syntax checks, and an isolated live Redis check covering concurrency and partial failures. The existing full integration suite was not run because its setup reads `config.json`.

Implemented JavaScript message filtering in [shared.py](/app/qutebrowser/browser/shared.py). The new `_js_log_to_ui` helper checks source and level rules, then source and message exclusion globs. Messages excluded from the UI still follow the existing logger path.

Added `content.javascript.log_message.excludes` in [configdata.yml](/app/qutebrowser/config/configdata.yml) and renamed the existing setting to `.levels`, with migration for saved values. Updated the settings reference and added [filtering tests](/app/tests/unit/browser/test_shared.py). Native subagents handled the config and docs, tests, and a read-only review; I integrated and verified their work.

**Verification:** 53 focused tests passed. A broader config file run had one unrelated failure: `test_nul_bytes` expects `ValueError`, while Python 3.11 raises `SyntaxError`.

Added [isFromProton](/app/applications/mail/src/app/helpers/elements.ts:44), which returns true only when `IsProton` is `1` for a message or conversation. The flag is now typed on both and preserved in encrypted search data. The column list uses it for the [VerifiedBadge](/app/applications/mail/src/app/components/list/VerifiedBadge.tsx:6) tooltip, while retaining the DMARC failure check.

Verification passed: 23 helper tests, the mail TypeScript check, targeted lint, and `git diff --check`. Three agents audited tests and UI behavior and handled type propagation; I reviewed and verified the integrated patch. Cached messages without the flag will show no badge until refreshed.

Resolved the `reversetunnel.Server` issue. [srv.go](/app/lib/reversetunnel/srv.go:93) now keeps one persistent `localSite` for connection registration, lookups, reconnect advisories, and proxy fan-out. Service connections reject empty or mismatched certificate cluster names. [localsite.go](/app/lib/reversetunnel/localsite.go:46) reuses the proxy’s existing access point and clients instead of creating a second resource cache.

I delegated the server refactor, constructor change, and test coverage to subagents, then reviewed the combined patch. The full `lib/reversetunnel` test suite passed offline; formatting and diff checks also passed.

Resolved the startup release issue. Builds with `-rc`, `-snapshot`, or other prerelease identifiers are no longer treated as proper releases. [main.go](/app/cmd/flipt/main.go) now uses the new [release package](/app/internal/release/check.go) for update status, reports the result in the configured output mode, and disables telemetry for nonrelease and CI builds. Failed update checks log a warning and allow startup to continue. Metadata retains the actual build version.

A subagent implemented the release package and its tests; a second independently reviewed the integration. I integrated the changes and verified them with `go test ./cmd/flipt ./internal/release ./internal/info ./internal/telemetry` using offline module settings.

Implemented album image tracking in `/app`. Directory scans now collect every image filename, and album refreshes combine those names with sorted, distinct media directories to store full paths separated by `filepath.ListSeparator`. The [Album model](/app/model/album.go:10) exposes the field, and the [migration](/app/db/migration/20261022120000_add_album_image_files.go:13) adds `album.image_files` and triggers a full rescan.

I delegated the model, migration, and scanner changes, then integrated and reviewed the patch. Model, database, persistence, and scanner tests passed with downloads disabled; `git diff --check` passed.

Updated [useShouldMoveOut](/app/applications/mail/src/app/hooks/useShouldMoveOut.ts) to call `onBack` only after element loading finishes and the active ID is missing from the valid IDs. [MailboxContainer](/app/applications/mail/src/app/containers/mailbox/MailboxContainer.tsx) now passes those IDs and loading state to both views; conversation view selects the message ID for message-level labels.

Three subagents handled the hook and view edits; I integrated and reviewed the patch. **Verification passed:** 31 relevant Jest tests, the mail TypeScript check, ESLint, and `git diff --check`.

Added [DefaultConfig](/app/internal/config/config.go:63) and exported [DecodeHooks](/app/internal/config/config.go:18); `Load` now composes those hooks. Storage `Local` and `Git` use pointers with nil-safe validation. I also fixed the CUE `bool` type and made the default YAML templates parse as empty mappings.

Two subagents reviewed the schema and updated the tests. `go test ./internal/config ./internal/cmd` passes with network access disabled. Local CUE checks validated both default YAML files and `config/production.yml`; a decode check covered durations and Git basic auth.

Fixed call sound playback in [LegacyCallHandler.tsx](/app/src/LegacyCallHandler.tsx): ring, ringback, busy, and call-end audio now unmute immediately before each `play()` attempt, including queued replays. `AudioID` is exported for consistent use elsewhere.

Added the public [handleEvent listener](/app/src/legacy/LegacyCallHandler/handleEvent.ts) with structured error logging and debug logging controlled by the new setting. I delegated the code and test audit and the listener implementation, then reviewed the combined patch.

Verification passed: 20 tests across three focused suites, TypeScript, targeted ESLint, and `git diff --check`.

Implemented NVD CVSS v4.0 ingestion. [Conversion](/app/models/utils.go:122) now stores each metric’s score, vector, and severity with its source alongside v2/v3 data. [Aggregation](/app/models/vulninfos.go:612) returns MITRE entries before NVD entries. The requested `CveContent` fields were already present; the dictionary dependency was updated to expose `Nvd.Cvss40`.

I delegated conversion, aggregation, and a read-only review, then verified the combined patch. Offline `go test ./models -count=1`, `go test ./detector -count=1`, formatting, and `git diff --check` all passed.

Polling now has a managed lifecycle. The [Poller](/app/internal/storage/fs/poll.go) owns its context and update callback, and `Close()` cancels polling and waits for the goroutine to finish. Git, local, S3, Azure Blob, and OCI snapshot stores retain their pollers and expose `Close()`, which is safe when no polling is active. The [filesystem store](/app/internal/storage/fs/store.go) forwards closure, and [gRPC shutdown](/app/internal/cmd/grpc.go) invokes it.

I delegated the poller, Git/local, and S3/Azure/OCI changes to three agents, then reviewed and verified the combined patch. Relevant storage and command package tests passed, as did a focused poller race test. S3 and Azure endpoint-backed integration tests were skipped because no endpoints were configured.

Resolved the OCI storage configuration issue. The loader now requires a repository and uses the OCI parser, so an unsupported scheme returns the specified error. It parses `bundles_directory`, authentication credentials, and duration strings for `poll_interval`. The server passes those settings to the OCI backend, and [DefaultBundleDir](/app/internal/config/storage.go:265) creates the default bundle directory. The CUE and JSON schemas and the `fs/oci` integration and CI entries are updated.

Three native subagents handled the store, schema, and integration changes; I reviewed and verified the combined patch. The focused Go tests, build testing package, and a local OCI bundle build/list smoke check passed. The full Dagger integration suite could not run because Dagger is unavailable locally.

Updated [collection.py](/app/lib/ansible/galaxy/collection.py) so builds preserve internal file and directory symlinks with relative targets, copy external file links as regular files, and avoid expanding linked directories in the manifest. Installation now restores links only when their targets resolve within the collection destination; tar helpers expose both the member and its stream.

Three subagents helped update [build tests](/app/test/units/galaxy/test_collection.py), add [install and safety tests](/app/test/units/galaxy/test_collection_install.py), and review the patch. **All 156 Galaxy unit tests pass**, as do `git diff --check` and Python compilation.

If a link’s target was excluded from the tar, install restores the safe link, but cannot verify the target content checksum.

Added [DeviceVerificationStatusCard.tsx](/app/src/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceVerificationStatusCard.tsx) to provide the localized verified and unverified copy. [CurrentDeviceSection.tsx](/app/src/components/views/settings/devices/CurrentDeviceSection.tsx) now uses it, and [DeviceDetails.tsx](/app/src/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceDetails.tsx) renders it immediately after the heading.

A delegated agent updated the focused tests and snapshots. The wider device settings run passed: **13 suites, 58 tests, 25 snapshots**. Changed-file lint passed. The full TypeScript check still fails on unrelated SDK compatibility errors outside the changed files.

Token-only invitation registration now works. The [registration form](/app/public/src/client/register.js) puts the URL token in its hidden input. The [backend](/app/src/controllers/authentication.js) registers without an email, confirms it only when it matches the invitation, joins the token’s groups, and cleans up invitation records. [Invitation storage](/app/src/user/invite.js) is now keyed by token.

Verification passed: 32 invitation tests, 30 authentication tests, targeted ESLint, and syntax checks. I delegated the form and invitation changes to two agents, used a third for read-only review, then integrated and verified the patch.

Implemented trusted reverse proxy login. Navidrome now checks the original connection address against `ReverseProxyWhitelist`, reads the username from `ReverseProxyUserHeader` (default `Remote-User`), creates users on first login, and returns authentication data to the frontend only for trusted requests. The frontend stores the resulting session, and log redaction now covers sensitive values in nested maps. Configuration and its security implications are documented in [README.md](/app/README.md).

I delegated IP validation, frontend session handling, and log redaction, then integrated and reviewed their changes. The relevant Go tests, all 38 UI tests, UI lint and formatting checks, and `git diff --check` passed.

Implemented opportunistic TTL eviction in [SimpleCache](/app/utils/cache/simple_cache.go). An atomic deadline triggers removal when an item can expire; `Keys()` and the new `Values()` method expose only active entries, and loader inserts sweep expired items first. [playTracker](/app/core/scrobbler/play_tracker.go) now reads active values directly.

Subagents added [cache tests](/app/utils/cache/simple_cache_test.go) and updated playTracker; I reviewed and integrated both changes. `go test -race -count=1 ./utils/cache`, `go test -count=1 ./core/scrobbler ./scanner`, and `git diff --check` passed.

Added filesystem completion to `:open`. The new [FilePathCategory](/app/qutebrowser/completion/models/filepathcategory.py) suggests sorted local paths for absolute paths, `file:///` URLs, and `~` paths. Empty input shows exactly the configured favorites. The [URL model](/app/qutebrowser/completion/models/urlmodel.py) includes Filesystem when enabled and respects the configured category order.

Updated [configuration](/app/qutebrowser/config/configdata.yml) and [help](/app/doc/help/settings.asciidoc) for `completion.favorite_paths` and the new `filesystem` category. Native agents handled the config/help and test changes; I integrated and verified their work.

Verification: the completion and config-data suites passed with **325 passed, 1 skipped, 1 expected failure**.

Implemented `override-validation=true` on the import API. The flag reaches `load()` and `validate_record()`, where it bypasses the specified publication-year, publisher, and ISBN checks. Without the flag, those checks still raise as before; required-field checks remain active. Added the case-insensitive `is_promise_item` utility.

I delegated the API and utility changes to two subagents, then integrated and verified the patch. Relevant tests: **147 passed, 1 expected failure**. Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.
